datasets.title: Africa–Asia bilateral product trade
datasets.description: Annual UN Comtrade extracts for food, apparel, fertilizers, natural rubber, and minerals and energy the observatory tracks, including crude petroleum, coal, liquefied natural gas, propane, butanes, gaseous natural gas, iron ore, copper ores, copper cathodes, gold, platinum, silver, wood in the rough, sawnwood, bauxite, unwrought unalloyed aluminum, unwrought aluminum alloys, manganese ores, chromium ores, cobalt ores, cobalt oxides and hydroxides, and unwrought cobalt. Bilateral statistical values, not orders or inventory. A missing pair is not zero trade. Do not add a line to its chapter or to a sibling product, crude petroleum to coal, copper ore to copper cathodes, unwrought gold to semi-manufactured gold, logs to sawnwood, or bauxite to either aluminum line. Unwrought and semi-manufactured gold, unwrought and semi-manufactured platinum, and unwrought silver are separate lines. Wood in the rough and sawnwood are separate lines. Do not add a cubic-meter volume to the net weight. Bauxite, unwrought unalloyed aluminum, and unwrought aluminum alloys are separate lines. Liquefied natural gas, propane, butanes, and gaseous natural gas are separate lines. Do not add them to crude petroleum or to one another. A kilogram of LNG is not a million British thermal units. Manganese ore, chromium ore, cobalt ore, cobalt oxides and hydroxides, and unwrought cobalt are separate lines.
datasets.source: United Nations Comtrade, public preview API
datasets.license: UN Comtrade terms of use; attribute United Nations Comtrade

datasets.title: Reference prices for observatory commodities
datasets.description: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly nominal US dollar quotes from January 2015 for the commodities the observatory tracks, including Brent and Dubai crude, South African coal, iron ore, copper, and aluminum. A missing month was not published. Not bilateral unit values. Brent and Dubai are alternative benchmarks. Iron ore is dollars per dry metric ton. The copper quote is refined metal, not copper ore. Gold, platinum, and silver are US dollars per troy ounce and are not added together. The gold quote is linked to unwrought gold, not semi-manufactured gold. Cameroon and Malaysian log quotes, and the two sawnwood quotes, are dollars per cubic meter and are not added together. The aluminum quote is LME unalloyed metal in dollars per metric ton, linked to unwrought unalloyed aluminum, not bauxite and not aluminum alloys. US natural gas, Europe natural gas, and Japan liquefied natural gas are dollars per million British thermal units and are not added together. The Japan quote is linked to liquefied natural gas, not propane, butanes, or gaseous natural gas. The natural gas index is not stored. The Pink Sheet has no series for manganese, chromium, cobalt, propane, or butanes.
datasets.source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), workbook updated on November 03, 2026
datasets.license: World Bank open data terms (generally CC BY 4.0)
